sense: a standard amount used in measuring

terms.gloss: a measure; a unit of measurement
evidence: Plin. NH 7.198: mēnsūrās et pondera invēnit Phīdōn Argīvus (Lewis & Short)
Nep. Att. 2.6: quī modus mēnsūrae medimnus appellātur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: modus mēnsūrae, a unit of measure.

phrases.latin: nec minus mēnsūrārum ratiōnēs, quae in omnibus operibus videntur necessāriae esse, ex corporis membrīs collēgērunt, utī digitum, palmum, pedem, cubitum
phrases.english: the units of measurement too, which every kind of work seems to need, they took from the parts of the body: the finger, the palm, the foot, the cubit

sources: Lewis & Short: mensura · Lewis & Short: modus
